items.condition: A model has wrong connectivity, E/Z identity, tautomer, charge, multiplicity or source-label correspondence; invalidate that model's scientific evidence, not unrelated correct work.
items.expected_action: Identify the mismatched model and withhold credit that depends on it.

items.condition: The claimed complete comparison lacks two genuine converged, validated local minima or their required geometry coverage; treat it as incomplete science, not a schema/transport failure or a valid mixed ranking.
items.expected_action: Give credit only for supported work; a bounded_failure explanation is not a substitute for a successful calculation.

items.condition: Fabricated evidence, hidden-answer leakage, or paper/experimental values presented as fresh calculations invalidate the submission under the existing runtime policy. Distinguish these from transparently incomplete work or an honest arithmetic error.
items.expected_action: Apply the existing invalid-submission policy (zero final score) to confirmed fabrication/leakage; trace claims to actual outputs. Do not apply this sanction merely for mixed rankings, failed computations or missing optional prose.

items.condition: Claimed comparison uses favorable row omission, row-wise sign flips or relabeling, wrong units or arithmetic, or a ranking inconsistent with the six valid metrics; withhold the affected metric/conclusion credit. A valid mixed/tied ranking itself is not a failure.
items.expected_action: Re-extract and compare using the public protocol. Optional commentary and absence of a limitations paragraph never trigger a failure.
